notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/c6d21527a99ab36782f1c31ce0bc4ba5b487b15b.png"]
New & Updated FeaturesOverhauled Onboarding
The onboarding flow to guide new Rumblers right into the action has been overhauled

This included a new stage explaining controls to new users
New Stages
3 brand new Stages have been added:

Pinball Carnival Run 2

Desert Ruins Survival

Green Hill Ring Battle
Skill Feature Improvements
We’ve updated the Skill UI 

A new stage to try out Skills has been added

Simply select a skill you want to test, and you are transferred into the Skill Test Room where you can use the skill against player dummies and reset the skill’s cooldown

Be sure to check out the How to Rumble video in the game for instructions on how to use Skills
Rouge’s Treasure Hoard
We’ve added a brand-new feature – unlock epic rewards for just playing!

This is a time-limited feature, so it won’t always be available

Save your Score Rank in Rouge's Treasure Hoard while the feature is active:

Play matches and fill up your progression bar

Score Boosters also count toward your progress

When the progression bar is full, open the Treasure Chest to claim rewards for free!

There’s a limit to how many times you can open the chest during the event

Open your chest for free when it’s full, or unlock greater rewards by purchasing an opening.

Since this is a new feature, we may tweak the type and amount of rewards over time.

If you receive a Score Booster but already have the maximum of 9, you’ll get Rings instead
Consolidated Missions
We’ve consolidated various missions and achievements that provide rewards into a single page.

This includes, for example, the following pages:

Limited-Time Events

Detective Agency

Squad Missions

Special Rumble Missions

Co-op Battle Missions

Score Rank Rewards

Achievements

Emblem Rank Rewards
Game Settings
We’ve added a resolution adjustment function
Balance AdjustmentsStarter Shop
We’ve reduced the number of items on the Starter Shop per page

Skins that were removed from the Starter Shop are now available in the Ring Shop

Please note: After this update, players must claim all Starter Shop items again to unlock the Ring Shop. As the following cosmetic items will no longer be available, we will distribute them to all users who have created an account prior to the update:

Emote: Unwind

Sticker: OK (Tails)

Cheerleader Rouge fragments x300

Emotes: Mission Complete, Rodeo, Jump, and Warm-Up 5 
Welcome Gifts
We have made an adjustment to the Welcome Gifts:

Day 2 reward changed from Headbanging (Emote) to Shadow (Skin)

Day 3 reward changed from Chao (Buddy) → Eggie (Buddy)

Please note: As the following cosmetic items will no longer be available, we will distribute them to all users who have created an account prior to the update:

Skins: Shadow

Buddy: Eggie

Sticker: Happy (Amy)

Emotes: Headbanging

Buddy: Chao

Effect: Golden Streak
Achievements
Several achievements were removed (for collecting items, login counts, friend requests, etc.), while others were simplified (Shop purchases, Ring totals, and Ring Survival) to improve the experience

In addition, rewards that can be earned through achievements have been changed.

Please note: As the following cosmetic items will no longer be available, we will distribute them to all users who have created an account prior to the update:

Eggman, M.D. fragments x100

Server Silver fragments x100
Skill Shop
Cream: Take Flight (Skill) has been changed to Amy: Hammer Attack (Skill)

The prices of the following Shop items have been adjusted:

Amy: Hammer Attack decreased to 200 Skill Stars

Cream: Take Flight increased to 1500 Skill Stars

Jet: EX Gear Flip increased to 1500 Skill Stars

Metal Sonic: Overheat increased to 1500 Skill Stars
Score Ranks and Reward 
SS & SSS Ranks have been added and reward more Skill Stars (from 500 to 1000).

First-time C Rank reward changed from Slide (Skill) to Sonic Chao (Buddy).

First-time B Rank reward changed from Stomp Attack (Skill) to Slide (Skill).

10× C Rank reward changed from 500 Skill Stars to Stomp Attack (Skill).

Individual Rank Rewards will be awarded based on post-update achievement status
Skin & Buddy Bonuses
Rare, Epic, and Legend rarity score bonuses adjusted.

Upgrade material (Wrench) requirements increased, especially for Epic Skins.

Slight increases for other cosmetics.
Other Adjustments
Ring rewards across the game have been decreased by 20%

Tune-up Wrench rewards have been decreased across the game by 40%

The rewards that can be obtained with Stage Points have been changed

The rewards that can be earned when increasing your Emblem Rank have been changed

Stage Challenge and Emblem Rank rewards expanded to include Eggman, M.D. Fragments and Server Silver Fragments

We’ve increased the maximum number of Score Boosters that can be held (from 9 to 99)

The maximum number of Score Boosters that can be purchased in the RSR Shop has been changed (from 6 to 10)

notes.title: Global Launch Update
notes.content:
We’re dashing into your feed today with an update on Sonic Rumble’s Global Launch and to answer the question on everyone’s mind: when will we open the floodgates to the chaotic, toy-filled world of Sonic Rumble?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/c323d0ef6fb1a02923f4807d24f608adbe480d35.png"]


Many of you have been wondering why the game hasn’t been released globally yet, even though it may seem ready. We’re very close and determined to fine-tune Sonic Rumble to ensure the best possible experience once we launch on a global scale. There’s still so much exciting content in the works that we haven’t revealed yet. From new characters, challenging stages, exciting features, to the most amazing crossover events, the team is building even more ways to keep the action fresh and fun.



A big focus right now is making sure the experience is even better for new players who haven’t had the chance to play yet, so some of these changes might not be as visible to those who tried the game in its early stages. We feel a special responsibility to get this right for the entire Sonic community and to deliver a competitive, party multiplayer experience that keeps everyone, new and returning players alike, happy and engaged.



The team is making incredible progress toward Global Launch in 2025, and we can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been building. We are more excited than ever to welcome you all into the game later this year. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey. Your support keeps us moving full speed ahead.



- The Sonic Rumble Team





Please note that the store pages might indicate a specific date for Sonic Rumble's release. However, this is a placeholder date. The actual release date for the Sonic Rumble Global Launch will be revealed at a later date.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
New Stages
More stages will be added in the future!
New Co-Op Battle Mode
Take on the Death Queen in our newest Co-Op Mode!
New Stage Challenges
Added the following Stage Challenges:

Green Hill Run 2

Frozen Factory Run 2
New Crew Feature
When you join a Crew, you can communicate and play together with your friends.

In addition, you can receive daily rewards and participate in special missions available only to Crew members.

Join forces with your Crew members to earn phenomenal rewards!
Rumble Ranking
Rumble Rankings is a new ranking system where you compete with other players in the same active league for the highest score.

The rewards you can obtain get better and better the higher you get your rank and league bracket to.

Aim for the top ranks by upgrading your Skin and Buddy Score Bonuses!

With the addition of Rumble Rankings, Season Ranking rewards will be discontinued.
New Skills Feature
A new Skills feature has been added that allows you to perform various actions while playing a stage.

Skills include effects such as increased movement speed, the ability to attack other players, and the ability to draw nearby Rings towards you.

Equip your favorite character with Skills to gain an advantage in battle!
Acquiring Skills
Skills can mainly be obtained via purchases at the Skill Shop.

To purchase Skills, you will need Skill Stars, which can be earned through missions and other activities.
Enhancing Skills
Skills have levels, and leveling them up strengthens their effects.

You will need Skill Stars to level up Skills. 
Changes to Enhancement Materials
The enhancement materials for Skins, Buddies, and Emotes have been changed to Tune-Up Wrenches.

As a result, the previous enhancement materials Slot Keys, Emote Pieces, and Fruit will be discontinued. 

Rewards in various areas have been adjusted to reflect these changes.

Any discontinued Enhancement Materials that you possess will be lost, but you will be compensated by the same amount in Tune-Up Wrenches. 
Changes to the Cosmetic Progression FeatureSkins & Buddies
The function to unlock equipment slots has been removed, and upgrading will now increase the Score Bonus value.

The Grade function for Skins has been removed and a new Level feature has been added.

Leveling up Skins and Buddies increases their Score Bonus values.

The system where Score Bonuses activated based on conditions or slots has been removed. Instead, the total Score Bonus value of all owned Skins and Buddies will be applied in battles.

The Enhancement levels of Skins and Buddies have been reset to coincide with these changes to the specifications. However, you will be compensated by the same amount reset in the form of Tune-Up Wrenches. 
Emotes
With the introduction of Skills, the upgrade and Score Bonus functions for Emotes have been removed.

Based on these changes to the specifications, you will be compensated by the same amount lost in the form of Tune-Up Wrenches.

Additionally, some Emotes will be re-released as Skills. (Punch, Kick, and more)

If you own any of the affected Emotes, they will be converted into Skills after the update.

Emotes that will be changed into Skills and were purchased with Red Star Rings.

Skill Stars will be granted as compensation for the discontinuation of Emote Score Bonuses.

Epic Emotes (99 Red Star Rings): 990 Skill Stars will be granted.

Eligible Emotes: Ground Punch, Finger Wag, Tail Copter, Shadowbox, Piko Piko Hammer, Crossed Arms, Hi There!, Overdrive, Charge!, Psychic Burst, Pyrokinesis, Jolly Flip, Goggle Fix, Booming Laugh, Time to Crash, Energy Ball, Overheat, Levitation, EX Gear Rush, Hammer Down

Legendary Emotes (149 Red Star Rings): 1,490 Skill Stars will be granted. 

Eligible Emotes: Breakdance, Volcanic Dunk, PDA Scan, Chaos Spear, Pyrotechnics, Hammer Attack, Screw Kick, Take Flight, World-Famous Treasure Hunter, Burrow
Changes to Score Rank Rewards
Rewards will now include Skills such as Stomp Attack, Baseball Slide, Kick, and Tackle.

Users who created an account by May 7th maintenance will receive the Skills Baseball Slide and Stomp Attack as compensation. 
Additional Improvements to Existing Features
Improved the UI and Ease of Play

Skin Filter Feature Added 

Customization Points Removed

Advertising Features Added 

Feature to Automatically Claim Mission Rewards Added

Explanation of Controls Added to Home Screen 
Homescreen Blur Setting
A highly requested setting has been added that allows you to toggle the blur effect on the Home Screen. You can find it under: 

Settings ⇒ Graphics ⇒ Home Screen Settings

Display background without blur: ON / OFF 

Changing this setting will prompt a game restart and may trigger an additional background asset download

notes.title: Sonic Rumble Global Launch Postponement Announcement
notes.content:
We’d like to update you on the status of Sonic Rumble’s Global Launch. Over the past few months, we’ve been working hard to bring the game to life, and we’re incredibly grateful for the valuable feedback we’ve received from players during the Pre-Launch period. The excitement and positive response from all of you has been truly amazing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/c323d0ef6fb1a02923f4807d24f608adbe480d35.png

Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve surpassed 1.4 million pre-registrations, a milestone that speaks volumes about your passion for Sonic Rumble. With this level of excitement, we feel an even greater responsibility to deliver an experience worthy of your time.

We’re also very proud of the amazing positive response Sonic Rumble has already received, with App Store ratings averaging 4.8.

As we prepare for Update 1.2, we’ll be introducing several exciting new features:


 Rumble Ranking – Compete within your league and earn rewards. 
 Crews – Team up with fellow Rumblers and take on the score missions together. 
 Skills – Equip characters with unique abilities, adding a new layer of gameplay depth. 

We’ll be sharing more details about these new features in the coming days, so even if you can’t participate yet, you’ll be able to stay in the loop and share your thoughts with us.

These upcoming changes will fundamentally reshape the game, and one thing has become clear: We want to create a game that evolves and stays fun for months and years to come. To build the kind of high-quality, long-lasting Sonic game our players deserve, we need more time.

As a result, we’ve decided to postpone the Global Launch. We know this news may be disappointing, and it wasn’t a decision we made lightly. We at SEGA share that disappointment, especially because we’re making this call so close to the launch timing we had originally hoped for. However, we believe taking this extra time is the right choice for the future of Sonic Rumble.

We don’t have a new release date to share yet, but as soon as we get closer, we’ll update you through our social media and community channels.

When we say your support means the world to us, we truly mean it. A strong community sticks together, and we’d love for you to join us for a special Q&A session on Discord, scheduled for May 2 at 1:00 PM UTC / 6:00 AM PDT / 4:00 PM EEST. We’ll answer your questions about the new features, the delay, the next steps, and more!

Your love and support mean the world to us. We are truly grateful.

- The Sonic Rumble Team


Please note that the store pages might indicate a specific date for Sonic Rumble's release. However, this is a placeholder date. The actual release date for the Sonic Rumble Global Launch will be revealed at later date.

notes.title: Coming This Spring—With Exciting New Game Modes and Features!
notes.content:
Sonic Rumble is coming this spring! Before it crosses the global release finish line, we're packing it with some exciting new content and features to deliver the best experience for our players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/df30e6301d7e8f1a51659d3f2ae7bd76ac068d40.png

Here's a sneak peek at what's coming soon:


 Quick Rumble - Just want to hop in and play? We've got you covered. Quick Rumble provides a bite sized one-round challenge for when you're short on time.
 Rival Rank - A new competitive mode where you can prove yourself and earn extra rewards.
 New "Crews" Feature - Band together to take on the competition and earn even more rewards.

But that's not all. We're making Sonic Rumble truly unique by embracing the abilities of your favorite characters from across Sonic's universe. Ever wanted to stun rivals with Amy's Piko Piko Hammer? Now you can! Selected characters get a set of unique abilities to shake up the competition.

We would like to extend a huge thank you to our players and Sonic fans for their patience in waiting for the global launch of Sonic Rumble. The team is committed to delivering a memorable experience for Sonic fans with even more new game mechanics, new features, and more exciting content to look forward to.

More details will be released as we get closer to Global Launch, but In the meantime join the community on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, subscribe to us on YouTube or TikTok, or jump to Discord for exclusive content.

Sonic Rumble launches this Spring on iOS, Android, Google Play Games on PC, and Steam.
